shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat rectangular stone panel
figures with arms raised/extended holding or gesturing
justification: Both surfaces present low-relief human figures rendered in strict profile on a flat panel, and in B two small kneeling figures with raised arms occupy the lower register while A shows one large standing figure grasping a tall spear. The dominant content differs sharply: B is overwhelmingly a dense grid of small pictographic signs in horizontal registers with tiny subordinate figures, while A is a single monumental figure with elaborate crown, beard and pleated robe filling the whole field and no script.
